title: LIVE: GMP student officer arrested on suspicion of rape and kidnap after M62 pursuit
excerpt: LIVE updates after a 23-year-old Greater Manchester Police student officer was arrested on suspicion of rape, kidnap and dangerous driving following a pursuit on the M62.
body:
LIVE UPDATES — This story is being updated as further confirmed information becomes available.

18:42 — Rochdale Daily has moved this breaking story to live coverage. We will add confirmed developments from Greater Manchester Police, the Independent Office for Police Conduct and other authoritative sources as they emerge.

WHAT WE KNOW SO FAR

A 23-year-old Greater Manchester Police student officer has been arrested on suspicion of rape and kidnap following a police pursuit on the M62.

The officer, who was off duty at the time, was detained in West Yorkshire after police traced his personal vehicle following a 999 call shortly before 10.20pm on Saturday. A woman in her 20s could reportedly be heard in distress during the call.

Police subsequently pursued the vehicle before the 23-year-old was arrested on suspicion of rape, kidnap and dangerous driving. He has been suspended from duty and remains in custody for questioning.

The woman is being supported by specialist officers and other agencies.

Greater Manchester Police has made a voluntary referral to the Independent Office for Police Conduct and said misconduct proceedings are also being progressed.

Assistant Chief Constable Mark Dexter described the allegations as deeply concerning and said specialist resources were investigating the incident. GMP said an initial review by its Professional Standards Directorate found that the officer's vetting had been completed without any reason for concern.

The allegations have not been proven and an arrest does not amount to a finding of guilt. This live page will be updated when further information is confirmed.
